title: Effectively Simple Habit Tracker
body: So many other habit trackers are overwhelming and complicated that I love how this app is so simple and efficient in creating habits!! The unlimited number of habits is lovely as well. Being able to look back at my progress and see the efforts I have made over the month/year is really effective in positively defining my efforts.
author: silaclight

title: Love this!
body: I’ve been trying to find an effective habit tracker that did discourage me when I missed a day and that don’t cost so much money for a subscription. This is absolutely free, you can add as many habits as you want, and you can see all of your history not just a month back. This is great! I highly recommend

author: LCAB07

title: perfect habit tracking app for me!!!!
body: This is the best habit tracking app I’ve ever tried!!!(I’ve tried many)Not only is it free, making it so much more accessible, but it is so simple yet so effective. I love customizing my habits including the icons next to my habits and I love how I can look back on my weeks and months that I have tracked and the streaks really help motivate me! I love that you don’t need to make an account to use it! I love how easy it is to mark off a habit and that I can set reminders as well. I can’t wait to see where this app continues to go and I would personally love to see them expand the habits to more than just weekly because there are some things I need to do biweekly and I’d love to track those as well!
